verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. 'When Life Is Rough' is pinned to the top and its 'PRAY' floats far below it, while the right pair sits on one line, so the two parallel phrases don't match. The two PRAYs are different sizes, the rose's top is cut off flat, and the rose is a small afterthought jammed to the right. A wins only slightly: its divider sits more evenly between the two groups, and its rose is a bit larger with less dead space on the right. B's divider crowds the left group and leaves an empty band to the right of the rose.
